sentences.en: I cannot put up with his bad manners any longer.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法忍受他的无礼举止。

sentences.en: Television enables us to learn about foreign manners and customs.
sentences.zh: 电视使我们能够了解外国的风俗习惯。

sentences.en: George did business in the same manner as his father.
sentences.zh: 乔治做生意的方式和他的父亲一样。
